$comment: CRM ↔ SITE Staff API contract (stage 4). Single source of truth: staff/router.php enforces method/path/permission/step_up/version/idempotency and validates requests; tests derive the RBAC matrix and validate responses; dev/crm-contract-gen.mjs generates crm.rubizh/src/contract.gen.ts and docs/crm/03-RBAC_MATRIX.md, 04-CRM_API.md.

conventions.csrf: every non-GET request carries the session CSRF token in header X-CSRF-Token or body field csrf
conventions.idempotency: routes with idempotent=true require header Idempotency-Key (32 lowercase hex) generated per user attempt; body request_id is a legacy alias
conventions.version: routes with version=required require body expected_version (order version hash); body version is a legacy alias; mismatch → 409 STALE_ORDER
conventions.step_up: routes with step_up=true require a password re-entry (POST /auth/reauth or login) not older than 900 s → 401 STEP_UP_REQUIRED
conventions.order_scope: write: MANAGER may change only orders assigned to self or unassigned (403 ORDER_NOT_ASSIGNED); payments/refunds are visible to MANAGER only for own orders
